# Order access review

## Scope
The review covers the saved handler and the selected HTTP exchange in the synthetic Shop API project.

## Observation
The handler reads an order using the supplied identifier. Whether middleware or database policies enforce ownership remains to be checked.

## Evidence
- `src/routes/orders.ts:41–49`
- Saved request: `GET /orders/42`

## Next checks
1. Inspect authentication middleware.
2. Compare access using two separate test accounts.

> This saved report records an observation; it does not contain an analyst decision.
